changes_from_v0: Scope narrowed to the three departments in the Knowledge Graph (Registration of Persons, Immigration & Emigration, Registrar General). The six services outside that scope are merged into 'unsupported_service'.
changes_from_v1_0: kg_service_id and kg_variant filled from kg_service_map.json (map 0.1, 2026-10-14). service_type enum changed from [normal, one_day] to [normal, urgent] to match C2's passport vocabulary; seed dialogues d002 and d018 updated. open_questions_for_kg replaced by open_questions_for_c2 from the map.

passport_new.note: The KG also has minor, diplomatic and official passport variants.

marriage_registration.note: id_status: proposed. Not yet in the KG; must be agreed with C2.

death_cert_copy.note: id_status: proposed. Not yet in the KG; must be agreed with C2.

unsupported_service.note: A real government service the KG does not cover yet (driving licence, police clearance, business registration, building permit, utilities, GN/residence certificate). System says it is not supported instead of guessing.

service_type.note: Passport service type, matching C2's passport vocabulary. 'One day service' in user text maps to 'urgent'.
